notes: Fixes N-R1 with a new line, T2 Ring Line: one closed double-track path round the primary ring (Harbour Road x 306, Comet Row z -726, Sunset Way x -346, Crown Road z 286). It closes on itself, so N-D1 and T-L1 need no loop. This is tide's two-way loop, built as a tram on the ring roads; it takes in T2 on Harbour Road.

Reach, worked by hand: harbour-east and docks-east (x 262) are 44 m from x 306. rocket-west and lantern-west (x -260) are 86 m from x -346. All four fall within reach 250 once stops are placed abreast of them.

T-C1/T-R1: the track runs 6 m outboard of each road's centreline (outer rail 7.8 m, kerb 12 m), so the R 50 corners stay in street space. At each corner the inner kerb point lies within the arc radius (32²+32² ≤ 50²; inner rail 2*30.2² ≤ 48.2²). On the centreline the arc would clip the corner plot.
Because of the offset, T2 runs in a kerbside reservation beside the 4 m median, not in it.
N-C1: T2 crosses S1 at (306,0), 34 m from S1 Harbour (340,0). T2 meets T1 on Comet Row at x 0, about 36 m from T1 Comet (0,-690). T2 also passes under S1 at (-346,0), where there is no station.
T2 crosses T1 at grade at (0,-726). No standard covers flat tram crossings; flagged for Keel and Splice, not assumed fine.

T1 is unchanged. S1 keeps its trunk to x 575 for Skyport spacing. Still open: notes › why contradicts notes › concept and looks stale (for Aster). The crown-circus 'via' is a chord polygon, a T-C1 risk for the T1 balloon.
Evidence: there is no shell in this run, so the plan checker was not run; all checks are by hand. `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` must exit 0 after Vantage places the stops.

handoffs.ask: Place T2 Ring Line stops on path 'ring', 300 to 500 m apart. They must include: Harbour Road near (306,-270) and (306,-510); Sunset Way near (-346,-300) and (-346,-560); an interchange near (306,0), within 150 m of S1 Harbour (340,0); an interchange on Comet Row near (0,-726), within 150 m of T1 Comet (0,-690). Then rerun N-R1.
S1 station spacing: Harbour (340) to Skyport (530) is 190 m, under 200. The trunk now runs to x 575. Move Skyport to about x 545 (fits 520 to 570 on the apron), or move Harbour to about x 325.
T2 is a closed two-way ring (about 3.3 km) with no termini; timetable it as continuous circulation both ways. It crosses T1 at grade at (0,-726), so the two timetables need to stagger there.
